'''David Wearne''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Los Gatos tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with JP Manipulator, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1471">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00d1471/ lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-lg-sj-super-saturday-11-18-00d1471/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
